svg.text: W05 Wallet audit (Ops manager) / My wallet (Rider)
Assignment screen 3: Audit trail. Read-only view of wallet_audit_logs with a date filter and running balance.

g.text: No edit or delete controls exist anywhere on this screen: the table is append-only in the database too.

svg.text: Ops can pick any rider (server-side search).

is locked to the acting rider.
